title: Term Life Insurance Rate Manual: Policy Fee, Modal Factors and Face Bands
content:
**Rate manual extract — Term Life Insurance.** The figures below are the product figures each tier's premium rules read: the flat annual policy fee, the modal factor for each premium mode, and the face band ladder.

## A. Annual policy fee and modal factors

| | Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term | Ashgrove Level Term 10 | Ashgrove Level Term 15 | Ashgrove Level Term 20 | Ashgrove Level Term 25 | Ashgrove Level Term 30 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Annual policy fee (USD per policy year) | 60.00 | 70.00 | 70.00 | 70.00 | 70.00 | 70.00 |
| Annual factor | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| Semiannual factor (each installment) | 0.52 | 0.52 | 0.52 | 0.52 | 0.52 | 0.52 |
| Quarterly factor (each installment) | 0.265 | 0.265 | 0.265 | 0.265 | 0.265 | 0.265 |
| Monthly bank-draft (EFT) factor (each draft) | 0.0875 | 0.0875 | 0.0875 | 0.0875 | 0.0875 | 0.0875 |

The modal factor is the multiplier applied to the annual premium for one installment of the mode. The policy fee is flat: it is added to the banded face premium and is not subject to the band factor.

## B. Face band ladder

The band whose lower face is the highest one not exceeding the face amount sets the factor applied to the face premium.

| Lower face of band (USD) | Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term | Ashgrove Level Term 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| 250000 | 0.92 | 0.88 |
| 500000 | 0.86 | 0.80 |
| 1000000 | 0.82 | 0.74 |

Reading the ladder (hypothetical faces): a face of exactly 250000 sits in the 250000 band; a face of 249999 sits in the 0 band; a face of 1000000 sits in the top band.
